name: ClaimFlow
tagline: AI-powered claims pipeline for auto insurance.
lede: Claims shouldn't wait on a desk. This system runs them through AI agents that assess damage and verify coverage in parallel, pulling in a human only when it truly matters.
description:
Most claims adjuster time goes to repetitive checks: does the damage match the story, is the policy active, does the payout math hold up.

That's what slows claims down, not the hard decisions, those often don't get flagged until a claim has already sat in the queue. ClaimFlow runs the repetitive checks in parallel the moment a claim arrives, and only pulls in a human when something actually needs judgment, high value, low confidence, a flagged inconsistency.
highlights: **Multi-Agent Processing:** Damage, coverage, and settlement are assessed by specialized agents running in parallel.
**Consistency Checking:** Flags and resolves conflicts between agents before a decision is made.
**Document Extraction:** Pulls structured data from uploaded reports and repair estimates automatically.
**Human-in-the-Loop Routing:** Pauses only the claims that need judgment, high value, low confidence, or flagged risk.
**Guardrailed Execution:** Every agent call runs under token, cost, and time budgets.
**Durable Workflows:** A paused claim survives a restart and resumes exactly where it left off.
**Evaluation Harness:** Scores each pipeline run against a golden test set and flags regressions across model swaps.

name: IT ServiceDesk Assistant
tagline: RAG-based SOP search for IT support staff
lede: Stop hunting through the knowledge base. This AI assistant finds the right SOP for each ticket, so IT staff can solve problems in record time.
description: IT staff spend a large share of each ticket searching the internal knowledge base instead of fixing the issue. The knowledge base contains near-duplicate and outdated articles that look correct. Choosing the wrong one leads to a slower fix or one that breaks something else.
highlights: **Ticket Understanding:** Reads a pasted ticket and identifies its issue category and error codes.
**Hybrid Retrieval:** Combines keyword and dense search to find the right SOP.
**Cited Answers:** Every answer links to its source SOP and last-updated date.
**Conflict-aware Results:** Flags outdated and current SOPs on the same topic.
**Role-Based Access:** Shows each staff member only the SOPs their team can see.
**Evaluation Harness:** Measures evals against a labeled test set on every run.
